executive_summary.text: Net sales came in at $6,975, up 8.1% over yesterday and 3.8% over last year, but 4.5% below budget, driven by a strong food and beer night that included a sold-out fish fry batch. Labor ran 27.4% of sales, 1.4 points over the 26% target, and a review flags a long burger wait during the Cubs rush when the grill was short a cook. Watch the grill staffing on event nights and the ice machine, now slow for a third night.

went_well.text: Net sales beat yesterday by $525 (8.1%) and topped last year by $255 (3.8%).
Food led all categories at $4,610 in net sales, with the fish fry among the top sellers at 41 orders and $779.
Overtime stayed at zero across 124.5 labor hours.
The marketing text campaign reached 212 guests with a 7.1% engagement rate on the one post published.

needs_attention.text: Labor ran 27.4% of sales, 1.4 points over the 26% target.
Net sales still missed budget by $325 (4.5%) despite the gain over yesterday.
One of four reviews was urgent, a 2-star report of a long wait on burgers.
Food variance cost came in at $176.40 against one item, worth checking against the $756 in monthly recoverable waste identified.

biggest_risk.text: Labor is running 1.4 points over target while a review points to a service breakdown from being short-staffed on the grill during a rush.

biggest_win.text: Net sales beat yesterday by 8.1% and last year by 3.8%, led by strong food and fish fry sales.

biggest_financial_opportunity.text: The kitchen has $756 a month in recoverable waste identified against tonight's $176 variance on one item.

biggest_staffing_concern.text: Labor ran 27.4% of sales, 1.4 points over the 26% target, on a night that already needed more grill coverage.

highest_priority_issue.text: A review reports a long burger wait during the Cubs rush, and labor is already over target, so grill staffing for event nights needs a fix before the next one.

largest_money_saving.text: The $756 monthly recoverable waste figure is the largest identified saving against tonight's $176 variance.

largest_guest_experience.text: One of four reviews tonight was urgent, a 2-star report tied to a long burger wait.

largest_staffing.text: Labor hours reached 124.5 with zero overtime, but the cost still ran 1.4 points over the 26% target.

actions_tomorrow.text: Reply to the urgent 2-star review about the burger wait and note the comp already given.
actions_tomorrow.why: One of four reviews tonight was flagged urgent with a negative sentiment score.

actions_tomorrow.text: Investigate the $176 food cost variance on the single flagged item before adjusting orders.
actions_tomorrow.why: Variance cost of $176.40 against one item is worth confirming before it's treated as waste or theft.

actions_tomorrow.text: Add a second grill cook for the next event-night shift, especially with a Cubs game or similar draw on the calendar.
actions_tomorrow.why: Burger tickets backed up when the grill ran one cook short during the Cubs rush, and labor is already 1.4 points over target so this must be a targeted add, not blanket overtime.
